idea-plugin.name: Diagram Source Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate from local Mermaid diagrams to Java declarations and source lines in IntelliJ IDEA.

Companion skill: use iibobo skills and its render-class-diagrams skill to generate offline HTML class diagrams with Java source mappings. Install the skill, generate a diagram from your Java sources, then open its HTML through this plugin. The skill creates the diagram; this plugin opens declarations in your current IDEA project.

  • Open project declarations, attached dependency sources, or decompiled JAR classes.
  • Resolve overloaded and inherited methods using fully qualified class and parameter mappings.
  • Use keyboard navigation and export a report of diagram navigation checks.
  • Process navigation locally with a project-scoped, authenticated loopback service; no telemetry.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.x with Java support. Open one or more trusted local HTML diagrams from the Diagram Source Navigator tool window or Tools → Open Class Diagram with Source Navigation. The diagrams must provide source mappings. Flowcharts generated with the compatible render-flowcharts skill can open a specific line in a Java source file.

中文：从本地 Mermaid 图表跳转到 Java 类、方法或指定源码行。导航在本机完成，不收集遥测。

配套技能：iibobo skills 中的 render-class-diagrams 用于生成带源码定位信息的离线 HTML 类图；本插件负责在当前 IDEA 项目中打开声明。 也可使用其他提供兼容源码映射的可信 HTML 类图。
